reviewBody: Gavin with the 500 IQ came over to adjust a screen that was seriously out of whack. It was misshapen to the point that it would let in massive bugs. It took multiple tries for him to fix it because it was such a challenge, but he nailed it. Now I can finally open my window and let the cool breeze in for the first time.

We had a great experience with getting our kitchen sink repair. Vince was able to fix 3 things at once including the garbage disposal, replacing the basket strainer, and replacing the faucet which were all broken. He worked quickly and professionally and even fixed the weatherproofing strip on our front door since he was here and it was quick 5 minute job to put in the new strip. In addition to being a very skilled handyman, Vince was friendly and kind to my elderly mother and brother as he was getting the job done. We'll definitely contact them again for future jobs as needed. Highly recommend the Knight Group for anyone looking for an honest, skilled handyman.
They did a great job with our small drywall install project and had fair pricing. Would use them again!
